title: May 15, 2026·China·ShengquCMS Classic CBT preview: 5 classes, level 100 cap, auction-house economyShengqu told players what is in the May 20 test. There are five first jobs: Warrior, Mage, Bowman, Thief, and Pirate. Classic maps are back, like Florina Beach and Sleepywood. The level cap is 100, and you can do your second job change. The big change is the economy: monsters do not drop equipment for trading like before. Instead, all equipment goes to a single auction house, and you buy it with points instead of gold. Gold is locked to your account, and you cannot drop or trade it. Face-to-face trading and street shops are gone.Closed TestPatch
